rationale: The agent performed order-changing actions (cancelling two pending orders and initiating returns) without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm before writes. While it looked up the user via email and retrieved order details, there is no clear authentication step beyond lookup. It did not address the user’s specific constraint about exchanging the loved boots only if an identical, cheaper pair exists, nor did it attempt or propose such an exchange. It also failed to provide the requested summary of how much money the user could get back today. The closing message suggests completion without necessary confirmation or final refund totals. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
